Closes #53

## What changed and why

Gitea records *that* an issue or pull request was closed, but not *why*. This PR adds the backend for a close reason: completed, not planned, duplicate of another issue, or other (with a short description). #54 (UI) and #55 (API) build on it.

- Issues and pull requests can store a close reason. Existing ones start with none.
- The timeline entry for each close keeps its own copy of the reason. Reopening clears the issue's current reason, but the history keeps what each close said.
- An invalid reason is refused and the issue stays open:
  - A pull request can't be closed as completed.
  - "Other" needs a description of up to 255 characters.
  - A duplicate must point to another issue in the same repository.
- Every existing way of closing works as before and records no reason: the close button, bulk close, commit keywords, merging, branch deletion and the API.
- The close form on the issue page can now send a reason, and shows an error message when the reason is refused. The inputs themselves come in #54.
- The contributor docs in `.claude-students` are updated.

## How the changes relate to the ACs

- **AC1:** after the migration, every existing issue, pull request and close entry reads as having no reason.
- **AC2:** closing with any of the four reasons stores it on the issue and in its close entry.
- **AC3:** a description that is empty, only spaces, or longer than 255 characters is refused, and the issue stays open. A valid description is stored exactly as typed.
- **AC4:** a duplicate that doesn't exist, is the issue itself, or is in another repository is refused. A valid one is stored, and its number, title and link can be shown.
- **AC5:** a pull request can't be closed as completed; issues can use all four reasons.
- **AC6:** reopening clears the issue's reason; the earlier close entry keeps its own.
- **AC7:** existing close paths are unchanged, and a merge records no reason.

## How it was tested

Mostly unit tests against the test database, plus one integration test that submits the real close form. To confirm the tests would catch mistakes, key lines were deliberately broken one at a time, and each break made a test fail.

| AC | What the tests check |
| --- | --- |
| AC1 | The migration on existing open and closed issues and PRs; a fresh install; old close entries |
| AC2 | Closing with each reason, directly and through the web form |
| AC3 | Empty, spaces-only and too-long descriptions are refused and the issue stays open; valid text is kept as typed |
| AC4 | Self, missing and other-repository duplicates are refused; a valid one is stored and loaded; a deleted target doesn't break the page |
| AC5 | The allowed reasons for issues and PRs; a PR closed as completed is refused |
| AC6 | Reopening after "other" and after "duplicate" |
| AC7 | Merging records no reason; the existing tests for the close button, the API, merging, commit keywords and branch deletion still pass |

The tests are in `models/issues/issue_close_reason_test.go`, `models/migrations/v1_27/v343_test.go`, `services/forms/repo_form_test.go`, `services/pull/merge_test.go` and `tests/integration/issue_test.go`.

**Not tested automatically:**
- Bulk close has no test. It didn't have one before, and this PR doesn't change it.
- The existing branch-deletion test only checks that the page loads.
- There is no UI to try by hand yet (#54).

**Verification run:** an automated run passed every build, lint and test check. A partial code review in the same run found three minor issues, listed below; none affect the acceptance criteria.

## Known limitations

- Closing with a comment and a refused reason still posts the comment. This matches how the existing "blocked by dependencies" refusal behaves.
- If the issue a duplicate points to is deleted later, the closed issue still refers to it, and the page treats it as not found.
- On MSSQL only, a description of more than about 127 emoji passes the length check but is too long for the column.

## Design

See the Design Decision section in #53.

## AI assistance

Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5) drafted the code, tests and docs and ran the checks. I made the design decisions, and reviewed and committed each change myself. AI log: see the AI Assistance comment on #53.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-09-27 23:15:34Z)**_

**It was caught, just not by a test.** I found it during the review of commits 1–3, and we left it as a known limitation. When I applied that cleanup I noted it was being left alone and said to tell me if you wanted it included. No test catches it, for two reasons:
- **Local tests run on SQLite,** and SQLite doesn't enforce `VARCHAR` lengths at all. A 1,000-character string saves fine.
- **CI does run the migration and integration tests on MSSQL** (the `test-mssql` job in `.github/workflows/pull-db-tests.yml`), but no test sends a description of more than about 127 emoji, so nothing there would hit it either.

**On the length check: no, it doesn't use an existing tool.** `Validate` counts characters itself, with `utf8.RuneCountInString`. Gitea's existing tool counts the same way, though. The form rule `binding:"MaxSize(255)"`, used for example on the new-issue title in `services/forms/repo_form.go`, is implemented as `utf8.RuneCountInString(str) > max`. Using it would have given the same MSSQL edge case.

It also only runs on web forms. `Validate` is in the model layer so it covers every close path, including the API later in #55, and that's why the check lives there rather than in a form tag.

One correction to something I said earlier. I told you issue titles don't have this problem. That's true, but it's not because of the form check. It's because the title-saving code *truncates* titles by display width, where an emoji counts as 2. AC3 says an over-long description is refused, not truncated, so that approach doesn't apply here.

I'd still leave it as a documented limitation, since the PR already lists it. If you'd rather fix it, `Validate` could count the way MSSQL does (UTF-16 units). That's a one-line change, but it would make every database refuse descriptions with many emoji slightly earlier than 255 characters.

## Known limitations

- Closing with a comment and a refused reason still posts the comment. This matches how the existing "blocked by dependencies" refusal behaves. A description that is too long is the exception: the form refuses the whole request, so nothing is posted.

```text
## Gotchas

- Two binding mechanisms with similar names: `web.Bind` (web, `services/forms` types) and the
  local `bind` helper in `routers/api/v1/api.go` (API, `modules/structs` types). Using the web one
  on an API route silently binds nothing useful.
- `web.GetForm` returns `any`. A wrong type assertion panics at request time, not compile time —
  match the type in `web.Bind` exactly.
- Adding a field to a `modules/structs` type without setting it in the converter ships a field
  that is always the zero value, and swagger will still document it as present.

## Related
=== guide traps ===
## Traps, and what they look like

**Your new API field is always empty — `0`, or `""`, or `false`.** You added it to the struct but
never set it in the converter. The field ships as its zero value, and the API documentation still
claims it is there, so consumers see a field that is permanently blank. This is the most common
mistake in this area and nothing warns you about it.

**Your form binds as empty on an API route.** You used `web.Bind`, which is the web mechanism over
`services/forms` types. API routes use the local `bind` helper with `modules/structs` types. The two
look alike and are not interchangeable.

**Your handler panics the moment someone submits the form.** `web.GetForm` returns an untyped value,
so a wrong type assertion is not caught at compile time — it explodes at request time. The type in
`web.GetForm` must match the type in `web.Bind` exactly.

**A list endpoint is mysteriously slow.** A converter in the loop is querying per item. Load the
data once before converting.

## Where to go next
```
</details></tool-use>

  ISSUE #53: backend to store and retrieve the reason an issue or PR was closed. UI display is issue #54, API access is issue #55 (both out of scope).
  
  ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (AC1 as amended):
  - AC1: Given a database with existing open and closed issues and PRs, when the migration runs, then the close-reason columns exist on the `issue` table and every existing issue and PR has an empty reason; existing close comments, which have no close-reason metadata, also read as having no reason.
  - AC2: Given an open issue, when it is closed through the close service with a valid reason (completed, not planned, duplicate or other), then both the issue and its new close timeline comment store that reason.
  - AC3: Given the reason "other", when the text is empty or longer than 255 characters, then the close is rejected with its own error and the issue stays open; valid text is stored exactly as entered.
  - AC4: Given the reason "duplicate", when the target number does not exist in the same repository or is the issue itself, then the close is rejected with its own error; a valid target is stored, and the close comment has the target issue loaded (number, title, link).
  - AC5: Given a pull request, when it is closed as "completed", then the close is rejected with its own error; the allowed-reasons list for a PR leaves out "completed" and an issue's list includes all four.
  - AC6: Given an issue closed with a reason, when it is reopened, then the issue's reason is cleared and the earlier close comment keeps its reason.
  - AC7: Given any existing close path (web, bulk, commit keyword, merged PR, branch deletion, API), when it closes an issue without a reason, then the close succeeds as before with an empty reason, and merging a PR still records no reason.
  
  DESIGN DECISIONS:
  1. services/issue CloseIssue is kept as a backwards-compatibility wrapper that calls the new CloseIssueWithReason with an empty reason; callers that should supply a reason are changed.
  2. Whitespace-only "other" text counts as empty (trimmed before the empty check).
  3. The issue table gets close_reason (Go type CloseReason int, SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 0 = none), close_reason_text (VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', only for "other") and close_duplicate_issue_id (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, the target's global issue ID). No database ENUM; values must never be renumbered.
  4. Close comments store reason, text and duplicate target in the existing Comment.CommentMetaData JSON field (written once, never updated), not new comment columns; migration only touches `issue`.
  5. Text sent with any reason other than "other" is rejected (ErrInvalidCloseReasonText); whitespace-only text counts as no text; stored text is empty unless the reason is "other".
  6. Validation happens in models/issues SetIssueAsClosed inside the close transaction (the merge path in services/pull/merge.go SetMerged calls SetIssueAsClosed directly).
  7. The duplicate target is given as the per-repository number (CloseReasonOptions.DuplicateIndex), resolved with GetIssueByIndex(issue.RepoID, n) inside the transaction, stored as the target's global ID on the issue and in the comment metadata; any issue or PR in the same repo, open or closed; self and other-repo numbers rejected with ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
  8. routers/web/repo/issue_view.go loads the duplicate target for close comments (Comment.LoadCloseDuplicateIssue, which also loads the target's repo so Link works), tolerating a deleted target (ErrIssueNotExist).
  9. The web close form handler NewComment (routers/web/repo/issue_comment.go) calls CloseIssueWithReason with the form's options and maps the three refusals to flash messages (keys repo.issues.close_reason.* in options/locale/locale_en-US.json). Bulk close (UpdateIssueStatus) keeps closing with no reason; the API stays with #55.
  10. The form sends close_reason as a name (completed, not_planned, duplicate, other); CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonOptions() maps it; empty = none; unknown = CloseReasonUnknown (-1), which Validate rejects.
  11. (latest commit) The web form's length check uses Gitea's standard binding rule: CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonText has binding:"MaxSize(255)" with locale:"repo.issues.close_reason.text" (label "Close reason description"), so over-long text is refused by form validation (NewComment's ctx.HasError → JSONError 400) before anything is posted. The model's Validate keeps its own 255-character check (utf8.RuneCountInString, the same counting MaxSize uses) as a backstop for paths that skip the form. The MSSQL limitation (NVARCHAR counts UTF-16 units, so over ~127 astral-plane characters pass the check but overflow on MSSQL only) is accepted and documented as MaxSize's behaviour.
  Other: reopening (setIssueAsReopen) clears the issue's three reason fields; comment metadata is untouched.
  
  ALREADY-KNOWN FINDINGS from a partial earlier review (confirm, refute or add new information; do not simply repeat them): (a) closing with a comment and a refused reason still posts the comment, as the existing dependency refusal does (except over-long text, now refused by the form before posting); (b) deleting the duplicate target leaves issue.close_duplicate_issue_id pointing at a missing issue (deleteIssue doesn't clear it; the loader returns ErrIssueNotExist, which the issue page tolerates); (c) the CloseIssue wrapper doc comment in services/issue/status.go names only automatic closes, but bulk close and the API also call it. These are listed as known limitations in the draft PR.
  
  AC → TEST MAPPING (claimed):
  - AC1: Test_AddCloseReasonToIssue (models/migrations/v1_27/v343_test.go); TestIssueCloseReasonPersists; TestCloseIssueRecordsReason/no_reason (models/issues/issue_close_reason_test.go).
  - AC2: TestCloseIssueRecordsReason (completed, other with text, not planned); TestCloseIssueAsDuplicate; TestIssueCommentCloseWithReason/not_planned, /other_with_text, /duplicate (tests/integration/issue_test.go).
  - AC3: TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate; TestCloseIssueInvalidReasonLeavesItOpen/other_with_no_text; TestCloseIssueRecordsReason/other_with_text, /other_text_is_stored_as_entered, /whitespace-only_text_is_not_stored; TestIssueCommentCloseWithReason/refused_reason_leaves_the_issue_open, /too_long_a_description_is_refused_by_the_form; TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonTextMaxSize (services/forms/repo_form_test.go).
  - AC4: TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate (duplicate cases); TestCloseIssueInvalidReasonLeavesItOpen/duplicate_of_itself, /duplicate_of_a_number_that_does_not_exist, /duplicate_of_a_number_only_in_another_repository; TestCloseIssueAsDuplicate; TestLoadCloseDuplicateIssueDeletedTarget; TestIssueCommentCloseWithReason/duplicate (also loads the issue page), /refused_reason_leaves_the_issue_open.
  - AC5: TestAllowedCloseReasons; TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate/completed_pull_request, /out_of_range; TestCloseIssueInvalidReasonLeavesItOpen/pull_request_closed_as_completed; TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonOptions.
  - AC6: TestReopenIssueClearsReason.
  - AC7: TestCloseIssueRecordsReason/no_reason; TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate/no_reason*; TestSetMergedRecordsNoCloseReason (services/pull/merge_test.go); existing TestIssueCommentClose, TestAPIIssue, TestPullMerge, TestUpdateIssuesCommit* (services/issue/commit_test.go), TestPullBranchDelete; existing dependency_test.go and issue_xref_test.go.

  CONTEXT — Gitea fork (CSCI 435 course), repo at /home/mantmant/Documents/CSCI435/gitea, branch feat/issue-53-issue-reason-backend, 13 commits ahead of main (main == origin/main), HEAD 773c614f56, clean tree. Review with: git diff main..HEAD.
  
  ISSUE #53: backend to store and retrieve the reason an issue or PR was closed. UI display is issue #54, API access is issue #55 (both out of scope).
  
  ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (AC1 as amended):
  - AC1: Given a database with existing open and closed issues and PRs, when the migration runs, then the close-reason columns exist on the `issue` table and every existing issue and PR has an empty reason; existing close comments, which have no close-reason metadata, also read as having no reason.
  - AC2: Given an open issue, when it is closed through the close service with a valid reason (completed, not planned, duplicate or other), then both the issue and its new close timeline comment store that reason.
  - AC3: Given the reason "other", when the text is empty or longer than 255 characters, then the close is rejected with its own error and the issue stays open; valid text is stored exactly as entered.
  - AC4: Given the reason "duplicate", when the target number does not exist in the same repository or is the issue itself, then the close is rejected with its own error; a valid target is stored, and the close comment has the target issue loaded (number, title, link).
  - AC5: Given a pull request, when it is closed as "completed", then the close is rejected with its own error; the allowed-reasons list for a PR leaves out "completed" and an issue's list includes all four.
  - AC6: Given an issue closed with a reason, when it is reopened, then the issue's reason is cleared and the earlier close comment keeps its reason.
  - AC7: Given any existing close path (web, bulk, commit keyword, merged PR, branch deletion, API), when it closes an issue without a reason, then the close succeeds as before with an empty reason, and merging a PR still records no reason.
  
  DESIGN DECISIONS:
  1. services/issue CloseIssue is kept as a backwards-compatibility wrapper that calls the new CloseIssueWithReason with an empty reason; callers that should supply a reason are changed.
  2. Whitespace-only "other" text counts as empty (trimmed before the empty check).
  3. The issue table gets close_reason (Go type CloseReason int, SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 0 = none), close_reason_text (VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', only for "other") and close_duplicate_issue_id (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, the target's global issue ID). No database ENUM; values must never be renumbered.
  4. Close comments store reason, text and duplicate target in the existing Comment.CommentMetaData JSON field (written once, never updated), not new comment columns; migration only touches `issue`.
  5. Text sent with any reason other than "other" is rejected (ErrInvalidCloseReasonText); whitespace-only text counts as no text; stored text is empty unless the reason is "other".
  6. Validation happens in models/issues SetIssueAsClosed inside the close transaction (the merge path in services/pull/merge.go SetMerged calls SetIssueAsClosed directly).
  7. The duplicate target is given as the per-repository number (CloseReasonOptions.DuplicateIndex), resolved with GetIssueByIndex(issue.RepoID, n) inside the transaction, stored as the target's global ID on the issue and in the comment metadata; any issue or PR in the same repo, open or closed; self and other-repo numbers rejected with ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
  8. routers/web/repo/issue_view.go loads the duplicate target for close comments (Comment.LoadCloseDuplicateIssue, which also loads the target's repo so Link works), tolerating a deleted target (ErrIssueNotExist).
  9. The web close form handler NewComment (routers/web/repo/issue_comment.go) calls CloseIssueWithReason with the form's options and maps the three refusals to flash messages (keys repo.issues.close_reason.* in options/locale/locale_en-US.json). Bulk close (UpdateIssueStatus) keeps closing with no reason; the API stays with #55.
  10. The form sends close_reason as a name (completed, not_planned, duplicate, other); CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonOptions() maps it; empty = none; unknown = CloseReasonUnknown (-1), which Validate rejects.
  11. (latest commit) The web form's length check uses Gitea's standard binding rule: CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonText has binding:"MaxSize(255)" with locale:"repo.issues.close_reason.text" (label "Close reason description"), so over-long text is refused by form validation (NewComment's ctx.HasError → JSONError 400) before anything is posted. The model's Validate keeps its own 255-character check (utf8.RuneCountInString, the same counting MaxSize uses) as a backstop for paths that skip the form. The MSSQL limitation (NVARCHAR counts UTF-16 units, so over ~127 astral-plane characters pass the check but overflow on MSSQL only) is accepted and documented as MaxSize's behaviour.
  Other: reopening (setIssueAsReopen) clears the issue's three reason fields; comment metadata is untouched.
  
  ALREADY-KNOWN FINDINGS from a partial earlier review (confirm, refute or add new information; do not simply repeat them): (a) closing with a comment and a refused reason still posts the comment, as the existing dependency refusal does (except over-long text, now refused by the form before posting); (b) deleting the duplicate target leaves issue.close_duplicate_issue_id pointing at a missing issue (deleteIssue doesn't clear it; the loader returns ErrIssueNotExist, which the issue page tolerates); (c) the CloseIssue wrapper doc comment in services/issue/status.go names only automatic closes, but bulk close and the API also call it. These are listed as known limitations in the draft PR.
  
  AC → TEST MAPPING (claimed):
  - AC1: Test_AddCloseReasonToIssue (models/migrations/v1_27/v343_test.go); TestIssueCloseReasonPersists; TestCloseIssueRecordsReason/no_reason (models/issues/issue_close_reason_test.go).
  - AC2: TestCloseIssueRecordsReason (completed, other with text, not planned); TestCloseIssueAsDuplicate; TestIssueCommentCloseWithReason/not_planned, /other_with_text, /duplicate (tests/integration/issue_test.go).
  - AC3: TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate; TestCloseIssueInvalidReasonLeavesItOpen/other_with_no_text; TestCloseIssueRecordsReason/other_with_text, /other_text_is_stored_as_entered, /whitespace-only_text_is_not_stored; TestIssueCommentCloseWithReason/refused_reason_leaves_the_issue_open, /too_long_a_description_is_refused_by_the_form; TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonTextMaxSize (services/forms/repo_form_test.go).
  - AC4: TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate (duplicate cases); TestCloseIssueInvalidReasonLeavesItOpen/duplicate_of_itself, /duplicate_of_a_number_that_does_not_exist, /duplicate_of_a_number_only_in_another_repository; TestCloseIssueAsDuplicate; TestLoadCloseDuplicateIssueDeletedTarget; TestIssueCommentCloseWithReason/duplicate (also loads the issue page), /refused_reason_leaves_the_issue_open.
  - AC5: TestAllowedCloseReasons; TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate/completed_pull_request, /out_of_range; TestCloseIssueInvalidReasonLeavesItOpen/pull_request_closed_as_completed; TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonOptions.
  - AC6: TestReopenIssueClearsReason.
  - AC7: TestCloseIssueRecordsReason/no_reason; TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate/no_reason*; TestSetMergedRecordsNoCloseReason (services/pull/merge_test.go); existing TestIssueCommentClose, TestAPIIssue, TestPullMerge, TestUpdateIssuesCommit* (services/issue/commit_test.go), TestPullBranchDelete; existing dependency_test.go and issue_xref_test.go.
  - Declared not covered: AC3 over-255 through a full model close only via Validate; bulk close has no test (pre-existing, code unchanged); TestPullBranchDelete only checks the page loads.

  ISSUE #53: backend to store and retrieve the reason an issue or PR was closed. UI display is issue #54, API access is issue #55 (both out of scope).
  
  ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (AC1 as amended):
  - AC1: Given a database with existing open and closed issues and PRs, when the migration runs, then the close-reason columns exist on the `issue` table and every existing issue and PR has an empty reason; existing close comments, which have no close-reason metadata, also read as having no reason.
  - AC2: Given an open issue, when it is closed through the close service with a valid reason (completed, not planned, duplicate or other), then both the issue and its new close timeline comment store that reason.
  - AC3: Given the reason "other", when the text is empty or longer than 255 characters, then the close is rejected with its own error and the issue stays open; valid text is stored exactly as entered.
  - AC4: Given the reason "duplicate", when the target number does not exist in the same repository or is the issue itself, then the close is rejected with its own error; a valid target is stored, and the close comment has the target issue loaded (number, title, link).
  - AC5: Given a pull request, when it is closed as "completed", then the close is rejected with its own error; the allowed-reasons list for a PR leaves out "completed" and an issue's list includes all four.
  - AC6: Given an issue closed with a reason, when it is reopened, then the issue's reason is cleared and the earlier close comment keeps its reason.
  - AC7: Given any existing close path (web, bulk, commit keyword, merged PR, branch deletion, API), when it closes an issue without a reason, then the close succeeds as before with an empty reason, and merging a PR still records no reason.
  
  DESIGN DECISIONS:
  1. services/issue CloseIssue is kept as a backwards-compatibility wrapper that calls the new CloseIssueWithReason with an empty reason; callers that should supply a reason are changed.
  2. Whitespace-only "other" text counts as empty (trimmed before the empty check).
  3. The issue table gets close_reason (Go type CloseReason int, SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 0 = none), close_reason_text (VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', only for "other") and close_duplicate_issue_id (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, the target's global issue ID). No database ENUM; values must never be renumbered.
  4. Close comments store reason, text and duplicate target in the existing Comment.CommentMetaData JSON field (written once, never updated), not new comment columns; migration only touches `issue`.
  5. Text sent with any reason other than "other" is rejected (ErrInvalidCloseReasonText); whitespace-only text counts as no text; stored text is empty unless the reason is "other".
  6. Validation happens in models/issues SetIssueAsClosed inside the close transaction (the merge path in services/pull/merge.go SetMerged calls SetIssueAsClosed directly).
  7. The duplicate target is given as the per-repository number (CloseReasonOptions.DuplicateIndex), resolved with GetIssueByIndex(issue.RepoID, n) inside the transaction, stored as the target's global ID on the issue and in the comment metadata; any issue or PR in the same repo, open or closed; self and other-repo numbers rejected with ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
  8. routers/web/repo/issue_view.go loads the duplicate target for close comments (Comment.LoadCloseDuplicateIssue, which also loads the target's repo so Link works), tolerating a deleted target (ErrIssueNotExist).
  9. The web close form handler NewComment (routers/web/repo/issue_comment.go) calls CloseIssueWithReason with the form's options and maps the three refusals to flash messages (keys repo.issues.close_reason.* in options/locale/locale_en-US.json). Bulk close (UpdateIssueStatus) keeps closing with no reason; the API stays with #55.
  10. The form sends close_reason as a name (completed, not_planned, duplicate, other); CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonOptions() maps it; empty = none; unknown = CloseReasonUnknown (-1), which Validate rejects.
  11. (latest commit) The web form's length check uses Gitea's standard binding rule: CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonText has binding:"MaxSize(255)" with locale:"repo.issues.close_reason.text" (label "Close reason description"), so over-long text is refused by form validation (NewComment's ctx.HasError → JSONError 400) before anything is posted. The model's Validate keeps its own 255-character check (utf8.RuneCountInString, the same counting MaxSize uses) as a backstop for paths that skip the form. The MSSQL limitation (NVARCHAR counts UTF-16 units, so over ~127 astral-plane characters pass the check but overflow on MSSQL only) is accepted and documented as MaxSize's behaviour.
  Other: reopening (setIssueAsReopen) clears the issue's three reason fields; comment metadata is untouched.

The web close form handler NewComment (routers/web/repo/issue_comment.go) calls CloseIssueWithReason with the form's options and maps the three refusals to flash messages (keys repo.issues.close_reason.* in options/locale/locale_en-US.json). Bulk close (UpdateIssueStatus) keeps closing with no reason; the API stays with #55.
  10. The form sends close_reason as a name (completed, not_planned, duplicate, other); CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonOptions() maps it; empty = none; unknown = CloseReasonUnknown (-1), which Validate rejects.
  11. (latest commit) The web form's length check uses Gitea's standard binding rule: CreateCommentForm.CloseReasonText has binding:"MaxSize(255)" with locale:"repo.issues.close_reason.text" (label "Close reason description"), so over-long text is refused by form validation (NewComment's ctx.HasError → JSONError 400) before anything is posted. The model's Validate keeps its own 255-character check (utf8.RuneCountInString, the same counting MaxSize uses) as a backstop for paths that skip the form. The MSSQL limitation (NVARCHAR counts UTF-16 units, so over ~127 astral-plane characters pass the check but overflow on MSSQL only) is accepted and documented as MaxSize's behaviour.
  Other: reopening (setIssueAsReopen) clears the issue's three reason fields; comment metadata is untouched.
  
  ALREADY-KNOWN FINDINGS from a partial earlier review (confirm, refute or add new information; do not simply repeat them): (a) closing with a comment and a refused reason still posts the comment, as the existing dependency refusal does (except over-long text, now refused by the form before posting); (b) deleting the duplicate target leaves issue.close_duplicate_issue_id pointing at a missing issue (deleteIssue doesn't clear it; the loader returns ErrIssueNotExist, which the issue page tolerates); (c) the CloseIssue wrapper doc comment in services/issue/status.go names only automatic closes, but bulk close and the API also call it. These are listed as known limitations in the draft PR.

+// MetaCloseReason returns the reason recorded on a close comment; comments without metadata have none.
+// The duplicate target is not included: load it with LoadCloseDuplicateIssue.
+func (c *Comment) MetaCloseReason() CloseReasonOptions {
+	if c.CommentMetaData == nil {
+		return CloseReasonOptions{}
+	}
+	return CloseReasonOptions{Reason: c.CommentMetaData.CloseReason, Text: c.CommentMetaData.CloseReasonText}
+}
+

+
+// CloseReasonOptions maps the close reason fields; an empty name means no reason,
+// and an unknown one maps to CloseReasonUnknown so that Validate rejects it.
+func (f *CreateCommentForm) CloseReasonOptions() issues_model.CloseReasonOptions {
+	opts := issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Text: f.CloseReasonText, DuplicateIndex: f.CloseDuplicateIndex}
+	switch f.CloseReason {
+	case "":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonNone
+	case "completed":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted
+	case "not_planned":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned
+	case "duplicate":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate
+	case "other":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonOther
+	default:
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonUnknown
+	}
+	return opts
 }

+func TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		name string
+		want issues_model.CloseReason
+	}{
+		{name: "", want: issues_model.CloseReasonNone},
+		{name: "completed", want: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted},
+		{name: "not_planned", want: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned},
+		{name: "duplicate", want: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate},
+		{name: "other", want: issues_model.CloseReasonOther},
+		{name: "2", want: issues_model.CloseReasonUnknown}, // the stored number is not accepted
+		{name: "Completed", want: issues_model.CloseReasonUnknown},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		form := CreateCommentForm{CloseReason: c.name}
+		assert.Equal(t, c.want, form.CloseReasonOptions().Reason, "name %q", c.name)
+	}
+
+	form := CreateCommentForm{CloseReason: "other", CloseReasonText: "superseded", CloseDuplicateIndex: 3}
+	assert.Equal(t, issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: "superseded", DuplicateIndex: 3}, form.CloseReasonOptions())
+
+	unknown := CreateCommentForm{CloseReason: "bogus"}
+	assert.True(t, issues_model.IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed(unknown.CloseReasonOptions().Validate(false)))
+}
+
+func TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonTextMaxSize(t *testing.T) {
+	assert.Empty(t, binding.RawValidate(&CreateCommentForm{CloseReasonText: strings.Repeat("é", 255)})) // counts characters, not bytes
+
+	errs := binding.RawValidate(&CreateCommentForm{CloseReasonText: strings.Repeat("a", 256)})
+	require.Len(t, errs, 1)
+	assert.Equal(t, binding.ERR_MAX_SIZE, errs[0].Classification)
+	assert.Equal(t, []string{"CloseReasonText"}, errs[0].FieldNames)
+}

+	repo := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &repo_model.Repository{OwnerName: "user2", Name: "repo1"})

+	// closeWithReason opens a new issue, posts the close button with the given form fields and expects status
+	closeWithReason := func(t *testing.T, fields map[string]string, status int) (*issues_model.Issue, string) {
+		issueURL := testNewIssue(t, session, "user2", "repo1", "Title", "Description")
+		resp := session.MakeRequest(t, NewRequest(t, "GET", issueURL), http.StatusOK)
+		link, exists := NewHTMLParser(t, resp.Body).doc.Find("#comment-form").Attr("action")
+		require.True(t, exists, "The template has changed")
+
+		fields["status"] = "close"
+		resp = session.MakeRequest(t, NewRequestWithValues(t, "POST", link, fields), status)
+
+		index, err := strconv.ParseInt(path.Base(issueURL), 10, 64)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		return unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Issue{RepoID: repo.ID, Index: index}), resp.Body.String()
+	}
+
+	t.Run("not planned", func(t *testing.T) {

+		assert.Equal(t, issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned, issue.CloseReason)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("other with text", func(t *testing.T) {

+		assert.True(t, issue.IsClosed)

+	})
+
+	t.Run("duplicate", func(t *testing.T) {
+		target := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Issue{RepoID: repo.ID, Index: 1})
+		issue, _ := closeWithReason(t, map[string]string{"close_reason": "duplicate", "close_duplicate_index": "1"}, http.StatusOK)

+	t.Run("refused reason leaves the issue open", func(t *testing.T) {

+
+	t.Run("too long a description is refused by the form", func(t *testing.T) {

+// Copyright 2026 The Gitea Authors. All rights reserved.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+package issues
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strings"
+	"unicode/utf8"
+
+	"gitea.dev/modules/util"
+)
+
+// CloseReason records why an issue or pull request was closed.
+// It is stored as an integer, so existing values must never be renumbered.
+type CloseReason int
+
+const (
+	CloseReasonNone       CloseReason = iota // 0
+	CloseReasonCompleted                     // 1
+	CloseReasonNotPlanned                    // 2
+	CloseReasonDuplicate                     // 3
+	CloseReasonOther                         // 4
+)
+
+// CloseReasonUnknown is never stored: it stands for an unrecognised reason name, so that Validate rejects it.
+const CloseReasonUnknown CloseReason = -1
+
+// CloseReasonTextMaxLength matches the VARCHAR(255) close_reason_text column and the close form's MaxSize(255)
+// rule. Validate counts characters the same way MaxSize does, so paths that skip the form get the same limit.
+const CloseReasonTextMaxLength = 255
+
+// AllowedCloseReasons lists the reasons a person can pick when closing.
+// A pull request is completed by merging, so it cannot be closed as completed.
+func AllowedCloseReasons(isPull bool) []CloseReason {
+	if isPull {
+		return []CloseReason{CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
+	}
+	return []CloseReason{CloseReasonCompleted, CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
+}
+
+// CloseReasonOptions is the reason a person gives when closing an issue or pull request.
+type CloseReasonOptions struct {
+	Reason         CloseReason
+	Text           string // only for CloseReasonOther
+	DuplicateIndex int64  // only for CloseReasonDuplicate: the number of the issue it duplicates, in the same repository
+}
+
+// Validate checks the options for an issue or pull request, without looking anything up;
+// SetIssueAsClosed checks that the duplicate target exists.
+// CloseReasonNone is always valid, so close paths that give no reason keep working.
+func (opts CloseReasonOptions) Validate(isPull bool) error {
+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonNone && !slices.Contains(AllowedCloseReasons(isPull), opts.Reason) {
+		return ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed{Reason: opts.Reason, IsPull: isPull}
+	}
+
+	if opts.Reason == CloseReasonDuplicate {
+		if opts.DuplicateIndex <= 0 {
+			return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "no issue number given"}
+		}
+	} else if opts.DuplicateIndex != 0 {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "an issue number is only allowed with the duplicate reason"}
+	}
+
+	hasText := strings.TrimSpace(opts.Text) != "" // whitespace-only counts as no text
+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonOther {
+		if hasText {
+			return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is only allowed with the other reason"}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if !hasText {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is empty"}
+	}
+	if utf8.RuneCountInString(opts.Text) > CloseReasonTextMaxLength {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: fmt.Sprintf("text is longer than %d characters", CloseReasonTextMaxLength)}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed represents a reason that is out of range, or not allowed for the issue or pull request.
+type ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed struct {
+	Reason CloseReason
+	IsPull bool
+}
+
+// IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed checks if an error is a ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed.
+func IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("close reason is not allowed for this %s [reason: %d]", util.Iif(err.IsPull, "pull request", "issue"), err.Reason)
+}
+
+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}
+
+// ErrInvalidCloseReasonText represents close reason text that is empty, too long, or sent with a reason other than CloseReasonOther.
+type ErrInvalidCloseReasonText struct {
+	Reason CloseReason
+	Detail string
+}
+
+// IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseReasonText.
+func IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseReasonText)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid close reason text: %s [reason: %d]", err.Detail, err.Reason)
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}
+
+// ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate represents a duplicate target that is missing, is the issue itself, or is not in the same repository.
+type ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate struct {
+	Index  int64
+	Detail string
+}
+
+// IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
+func IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid duplicate target: %s [index: %d]", err.Detail, err.Index)
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}

+// MetaCloseReason returns the reason recorded on a close comment; comments without metadata have none.
+// The duplicate target is not included: load it with LoadCloseDuplicateIssue.
+func (c *Comment) MetaCloseReason() CloseReasonOptions {
+	if c.CommentMetaData == nil {
+		return CloseReasonOptions{}
+	}
+	return CloseReasonOptions{Reason: c.CommentMetaData.CloseReason, Text: c.CommentMetaData.CloseReasonText}

+	"testing"

+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func Test_AddCloseReasonToIssue(t *testing.T) {
+	type Issue struct {
+		ID       int64 `xorm:"pk autoincr"`
+		RepoID   int64 `xorm:"INDEX UNIQUE(repo_index)"`
+		Index    int64 `xorm:"UNIQUE(repo_index)"`
+		IsClosed bool  `xorm:"INDEX"`
+		IsPull   bool  `xorm:"INDEX"`
+	}
+
+	x, deferable := migrationtest.PrepareTestEnv(t, 0, new(Issue))
+	defer deferable()
+
+	require.NoError(t, AddCloseReasonToIssue(x))
+
+	var issues []struct {
+		ID                    int64
+		CloseReason           int
+		CloseReasonText       string
+		CloseDuplicateIssueID int64
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, x.Table("issue").Asc("id").Find(&issues))
+	require.Len(t, issues, 4) // guards against the fixtures silently not loading
+	for _, issue := range issues {
+		assert.Zero(t, issue.CloseReason, "issue %d", issue.ID)
+		assert.Empty(t, issue.CloseReasonText, "issue %d", issue.ID)
+		assert.Zero(t, issue.CloseDuplicateIssueID, "issue %d", issue.ID)
+	}
+}

+// Copyright 2026 The Gitea Authors. All rights reserved.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+package issues
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strings"
+	"unicode/utf8"
+
+	"gitea.dev/modules/util"
+)
+
+// CloseReason records why an issue or pull request was closed.
+// It is stored as an integer, so existing values must never be renumbered.
+type CloseReason int
+
+const (
+	CloseReasonNone       CloseReason = iota // 0
+	CloseReasonCompleted                     // 1
+	CloseReasonNotPlanned                    // 2
+	CloseReasonDuplicate                     // 3
+	CloseReasonOther                         // 4
+)
+
+// CloseReasonUnknown is never stored: it stands for an unrecognised reason name, so that Validate rejects it.
+const CloseReasonUnknown CloseReason = -1
+
+// CloseReasonTextMaxLength matches the VARCHAR(255) close_reason_text column and the close form's MaxSize(255)
+// rule. Validate counts characters the same way MaxSize does, so paths that skip the form get the same limit.
+const CloseReasonTextMaxLength = 255
+
+// AllowedCloseReasons lists the reasons a person can pick when closing.
+// A pull request is completed by merging, so it cannot be closed as completed.
+func AllowedCloseReasons(isPull bool) []CloseReason {
+	if isPull {
+		return []CloseReason{CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
+	}
+	return []CloseReason{CloseReasonCompleted, CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
+}
+
+// CloseReasonOptions is the reason a person gives when closing an issue or pull request.
+type CloseReasonOptions struct {
+	Reason         CloseReason
+	Text           string // only for CloseReasonOther
+	DuplicateIndex int64  // only for CloseReasonDuplicate: the number of the issue it duplicates, in the same repository
+}
+
+// Validate checks the options for an issue or pull request, without looking anything up;
+// SetIssueAsClosed checks that the duplicate target exists.
+// CloseReasonNone is always valid, so close paths that give no reason keep working.
+func (opts CloseReasonOptions) Validate(isPull bool) error {
+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonNone && !slices.Contains(AllowedCloseReasons(isPull), opts.Reason) {
+		return ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed{Reason: opts.Reason, IsPull: isPull}
+	}
+
+	if opts.Reason == CloseReasonDuplicate {
+		if opts.DuplicateIndex <= 0 {
+			return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "no issue number given"}
+		}
+	} else if opts.DuplicateIndex != 0 {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "an issue number is only allowed with the duplicate reason"}
+	}
+
+	hasText := strings.TrimSpace(opts.Text) != "" // whitespace-only counts as no text
+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonOther {
+		if hasText {
+			return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is only allowed with the other reason"}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if !hasText {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is empty"}
+	}
+	if utf8.RuneCountInString(opts.Text) > CloseReasonTextMaxLength {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: fmt.Sprintf("text is longer than %d characters", CloseReasonTextMaxLength)}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed represents a reason that is out of range, or not allowed for the issue or pull request.
+type ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed struct {
+	Reason CloseReason
+	IsPull bool
+}
+
+// IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed checks if an error is a ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed.
+func IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("close reason is not allowed for this %s [reason: %d]", util.Iif(err.IsPull, "pull request", "issue"), err.Reason)
+}
+
+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}
+
+// ErrInvalidCloseReasonText represents close reason text that is empty, too long, or sent with a reason other than CloseReasonOther.
+type ErrInvalidCloseReasonText struct {
+	Reason CloseReason
+	Detail string
+}
+
+// IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseReasonText.
+func IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseReasonText)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid close reason text: %s [reason: %d]", err.Detail, err.Reason)
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}
+
+// ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate represents a duplicate target that is missing, is the issue itself, or is not in the same repository.
+type ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate struct {
+	Index  int64
+	Detail string
+}
+
+// IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
+func IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid duplicate target: %s [index: %d]", err.Detail, err.Index)
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The Gitea Authors. All rights reserved.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+package issues
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strings"
+	"unicode/utf8"
+
+	"gitea.dev/modules/util"
+)
+
+// CloseReason records why an issue or pull request was closed.
+// It is stored as an integer, so existing values must never be renumbered.
+type CloseReason int
+
+const (
+	CloseReasonNone       CloseReason = iota // 0
+	CloseReasonCompleted                     // 1
+	CloseReasonNotPlanned                    // 2
+	CloseReasonDuplicate                     // 3
+	CloseReasonOther                         // 4
+)
+
+// CloseReasonUnknown is never stored: it stands for an unrecognised reason name, so that Validate rejects it.
+const CloseReasonUnknown CloseReason = -1
+
+// CloseReasonTextMaxLength matches the VARCHAR(255) close_reason_text column and the close form's MaxSize(255)
+// rule. Validate counts characters the same way MaxSize does, so paths that skip the form get the same limit.
+const CloseReasonTextMaxLength = 255
+
+// AllowedCloseReasons lists the reasons a person can pick when closing.
+// A pull request is completed by merging, so it cannot be closed as completed.
+func AllowedCloseReasons(isPull bool) []CloseReason {
+	if isPull {
+		return []CloseReason{CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
+	}
+	return []CloseReason{CloseReasonCompleted, CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
+}
+
+// CloseReasonOptions is the reason a person gives when closing an issue or pull request.
+type CloseReasonOptions struct {
+	Reason         CloseReason
+	Text           string // only for CloseReasonOther
+	DuplicateIndex int64  // only for CloseReasonDuplicate: the number of the issue it duplicates, in the same repository
+}
+
+// Validate checks the options for an issue or pull request, without looking anything up;
+// SetIssueAsClosed checks that the duplicate target exists.
+// CloseReasonNone is always valid, so close paths that give no reason keep working.
+func (opts CloseReasonOptions) Validate(isPull bool) error {
+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonNone && !slices.Contains(AllowedCloseReasons(isPull), opts.Reason) {
+		return ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed{Reason: opts.Reason, IsPull: isPull}
+	}
+
+	if opts.Reason == CloseReasonDuplicate {
+		if opts.DuplicateIndex <= 0 {
+			return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "no issue number given"}
+		}
+	} else if opts.DuplicateIndex != 0 {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "an issue number is only allowed with the duplicate reason"}
+	}
+
+	hasText := strings.TrimSpace(opts.Text) != "" // whitespace-only counts as no text
+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonOther {
+		if hasText {
+			return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is only allowed with the other reason"}
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+	if !hasText {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is empty"}
+	}
+	if utf8.RuneCountInString(opts.Text) > CloseReasonTextMaxLength {
+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: fmt.Sprintf("text is longer than %d characters", CloseReasonTextMaxLength)}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed represents a reason that is out of range, or not allowed for the issue or pull request.
+type ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed struct {
+	Reason CloseReason
+	IsPull bool
+}
+
+// IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed checks if an error is a ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed.
+func IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("close reason is not allowed for this %s [reason: %d]", util.Iif(err.IsPull, "pull request", "issue"), err.Reason)
+}
+
+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}
+
+// ErrInvalidCloseReasonText represents close reason text that is empty, too long, or sent with a reason other than CloseReasonOther.
+type ErrInvalidCloseReasonText struct {
+	Reason CloseReason
+	Detail string
+}
+
+// IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseReasonText.
+func IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseReasonText)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid close reason text: %s [reason: %d]", err.Detail, err.Reason)
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}
+
+// ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate represents a duplicate target that is missing, is the issue itself, or is not in the same repository.
+type ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate struct {
+	Index  int64
+	Detail string
+}
+
+// IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
+func IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate(err error) bool {
+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate)
+	return ok
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Error() string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid duplicate target: %s [index: %d]", err.Detail, err.Index)
+}
+
+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Unwrap() error {
+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
+}

+// Copyright 2026 The Gitea Authors. All rights reserved.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+package v1_27
+
+import (
+	"gitea.dev/models/db"
+
+	"xorm.io/xorm"
+)
+
+func AddCloseReasonToIssue(x db.EngineMigration) error {
+	type Issue struct {
+		CloseReason           int    `xorm:"SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"`
+		CloseReasonText       string `xorm:"VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"`
+		CloseDuplicateIssueID int64  `xorm:"NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"`
+	}
+	_, err := x.SyncWithOptions(xorm.SyncOptions{
+		IgnoreDropIndices: true,
+		IgnoreConstrains:  true,
+	}, new(Issue))
+	return err
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The Gitea Authors. All rights reserved.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+package v1_27
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"gitea.dev/models/migrations/migrationtest"
+
+	_ "gitea.dev/models/issues" // registers the issue table; fixtures for unregistered tables are skipped
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func Test_AddCloseReasonToIssue(t *testing.T) {
+	type Issue struct {
+		ID       int64 `xorm:"pk autoincr"`
+		RepoID   int64 `xorm:"INDEX UNIQUE(repo_index)"`
+		Index    int64 `xorm:"UNIQUE(repo_index)"`
+		IsClosed bool  `xorm:"INDEX"`
+		IsPull   bool  `xorm:"INDEX"`
+	}
+
+	x, deferable := migrationtest.PrepareTestEnv(t, 0, new(Issue))
+	defer deferable()
+
+	require.NoError(t, AddCloseReasonToIssue(x))
+
+	var issues []struct {
+		ID                    int64
+		CloseReason           int
+		CloseReasonText       string
+		CloseDuplicateIssueID int64
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, x.Table("issue").Asc("id").Find(&issues))
+	require.Len(t, issues, 4) // guards against the fixtures silently not loading
+	for _, issue := range issues {
+		assert.Zero(t, issue.CloseReason, "issue %d", issue.ID)
+		assert.Empty(t, issue.CloseReasonText, "issue %d", issue.ID)
+		assert.Zero(t, issue.CloseDuplicateIssueID, "issue %d", issue.ID)
+	}
+}

+	CloseReasonText     string `binding:"MaxSize(255)" locale:"repo.issues.close_reason.text"` // same limit as issues_model.CloseReasonTextMaxLength
+	CloseDuplicateIndex int64
+}
+
+// CloseReasonOptions maps the close reason fields; an empty name means no reason,
+// and an unknown one maps to CloseReasonUnknown so that Validate rejects it.
+func (f *CreateCommentForm) CloseReasonOptions() issues_model.CloseReasonOptions {
+	opts := issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Text: f.CloseReasonText, DuplicateIndex: f.CloseDuplicateIndex}
+	switch f.CloseReason {
+	case "":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonNone
+	case "completed":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted
+	case "not_planned":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned
+	case "duplicate":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate
+	case "other":
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonOther
+	default:
+		opts.Reason = issues_model.CloseReasonUnknown
+	}
+	return opts
 }
 
 // Validate validates the fields

+func TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		name string
+		want issues_model.CloseReason
+	}{
+		{name: "", want: issues_model.CloseReasonNone},
+		{name: "completed", want: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted},
+		{name: "not_planned", want: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned},
+		{name: "duplicate", want: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate},
+		{name: "other", want: issues_model.CloseReasonOther},
+		{name: "2", want: issues_model.CloseReasonUnknown}, // the stored number is not accepted
+		{name: "Completed", want: issues_model.CloseReasonUnknown},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		form := CreateCommentForm{CloseReason: c.name}
+		assert.Equal(t, c.want, form.CloseReasonOptions().Reason, "name %q", c.name)
+	}
+
+	form := CreateCommentForm{CloseReason: "other", CloseReasonText: "superseded", CloseDuplicateIndex: 3}
+	assert.Equal(t, issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: "superseded", DuplicateIndex: 3}, form.CloseReasonOptions())
+
+	unknown := CreateCommentForm{CloseReason: "bogus"}
+	assert.True(t, issues_model.IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed(unknown.CloseReasonOptions().Validate(false)))
+}
+
+func TestCreateCommentForm_CloseReasonTextMaxSize(t *testing.T) {
+	assert.Empty(t, binding.RawValidate(&CreateCommentForm{CloseReasonText: strings.Repeat("é", 255)})) // counts characters, not bytes
+
+	errs := binding.RawValidate(&CreateCommentForm{CloseReasonText: strings.Repeat("a", 256)})
+	require.Len(t, errs, 1)
+	assert.Equal(t, binding.ERR_MAX_SIZE, errs[0].Classification)
+	assert.Equal(t, []string{"CloseReasonText"}, errs[0].FieldNames)
+}

130	+
131	+// CloseReason records why an issue or pull request was closed.
132	+// It is stored as an integer, so existing values must never be renumbered.
133	+type CloseReason int
134	+
135	+const (
136	+	CloseReasonNone       CloseReason = iota // 0
137	+	CloseReasonCompleted                     // 1
138	+	CloseReasonNotPlanned                    // 2
139	+	CloseReasonDuplicate                     // 3
140	+	CloseReasonOther                         // 4
141	+)
142	+
143	+// CloseReasonUnknown is never stored: it stands for an unrecognised reason name, so that Validate rejects it.
144	+const CloseReasonUnknown CloseReason = -1
145	+
146	+// CloseReasonTextMaxLength matches the VARCHAR(255) close_reason_text column and the close form's MaxSize(255)
147	+// rule. Validate counts characters the same way MaxSize does, so paths that skip the form get the same limit.
148	+const CloseReasonTextMaxLength = 255
149	+
150	+// AllowedCloseReasons lists the reasons a person can pick when closing.
151	+// A pull request is completed by merging, so it cannot be closed as completed.
152	+func AllowedCloseReasons(isPull bool) []CloseReason {
153	+	if isPull {
154	+		return []CloseReason{CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
155	+	}
156	+	return []CloseReason{CloseReasonCompleted, CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
157	+}
158	+
159	+// CloseReasonOptions is the reason a person gives when closing an issue or pull request.
160	+type CloseReasonOptions struct {
161	+	Reason         CloseReason
162	+	Text           string // only for CloseReasonOther
163	+	DuplicateIndex int64  // only for CloseReasonDuplicate: the number of the issue it duplicates, in the same repository
164	+}
165	+
166	+// Validate checks the options for an issue or pull request, without looking anything up;
167	+// SetIssueAsClosed checks that the duplicate target exists.
168	+// CloseReasonNone is always valid, so close paths that give no reason keep working.
169	+func (opts CloseReasonOptions) Validate(isPull bool) error {
170	+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonNone && !slices.Contains(AllowedCloseReasons(isPull), opts.Reason) {
171	+		return ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed{Reason: opts.Reason, IsPull: isPull}
172	+	}
173	+
174	+	if opts.Reason == CloseReasonDuplicate {
175	+		if opts.DuplicateIndex <= 0 {
176	+			return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "no issue number given"}
177	+		}
178	+	} else if opts.DuplicateIndex != 0 {
179	+		return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "an issue number is only allowed with the duplicate reason"}
180	+	}
181	+
182	+	hasText := strings.TrimSpace(opts.Text) != "" // whitespace-only counts as no text
183	+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonOther {
184	+		if hasText {
185	+			return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is only allowed with the other reason"}
186	+		}
187	+		return nil
188	+	}
189	+	if !hasText {
190	+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is empty"}
191	+	}
192	+	if utf8.RuneCountInString(opts.Text) > CloseReasonTextMaxLength {
193	+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: fmt.Sprintf("text is longer than %d characters", CloseReasonTextMaxLength)}
194	+	}
195	+	return nil
196	+}
197	+
198	+// ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed represents a reason that is out of range, or not allowed for the issue or pull request.
199	+type ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed struct {
200	+	Reason CloseReason
201	+	IsPull bool
202	+}
203	+
204	+// IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed checks if an error is a ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed.
205	+func IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed(err error) bool {
206	+	_, ok := err.(ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed)
207	+	return ok
208	+}
209	+
210	+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Error() string {
211	+	return fmt.Sprintf("close reason is not allowed for this %s [reason: %d]", util.Iif(err.IsPull, "pull request", "issue"), err.Reason)
212	+}
213	+
214	+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Unwrap() error {
215	+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
216	+}
217	+
218	+// ErrInvalidCloseReasonText represents close reason text that is empty, too long, or sent with a reason other than CloseReasonOther.
219	+type ErrInvalidCloseReasonText struct {
220	+	Reason CloseReason
221	+	Detail string
222	+}
223	+
224	+// IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseReasonText.
225	+func IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText(err error) bool {
226	+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseReasonText)
227	+	return ok
228	+}
229	+
230	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Error() string {
231	+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid close reason text: %s [reason: %d]", err.Detail, err.Reason)
232	+}
233	+
234	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Unwrap() error {
235	+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
236	+}
237	+
238	+// ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate represents a duplicate target that is missing, is the issue itself, or is not in the same repository.
239	+type ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate struct {
240	+	Index  int64
241	+	Detail string
242	+}
243	+
244	+// IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
245	+func IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate(err error) bool {
246	+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate)
247	+	return ok
248	+}
249	+
250	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Error() string {
251	+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid duplicate target: %s [index: %d]", err.Detail, err.Index)
252	+}
253	+
254	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Unwrap() error {
255	+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
256	+}

322	+func TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate(t *testing.T) {
323	+	cases := []struct {
324	+		name   string
325	+		opts   issues_model.CloseReasonOptions
326	+		isPull bool
327	+		isErr  func(error) bool // nil when the options are valid
328	+	}{
329	+		{name: "no reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{}},
330	+		{name: "no reason on a pull request", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{}, isPull: true},
331	+		{name: "completed issue", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted}},
332	+		{name: "not planned pull request", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned}, isPull: true},
333	+		{name: "duplicate with a number", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate, DuplicateIndex: 3}},
334	+		{name: "other with text", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: "superseded"}},
335	+		{name: "other with 255 two-byte characters", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: strings.Repeat("é", 255)}},
336	+		{name: "whitespace-only text with another reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted, Text: " "}},
337	+
338	+		{name: "completed pull request", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted}, isPull: true, isErr: issues_model.IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed},
339	+		{name: "out of range", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: 99}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed},
340	+		{name: "other with no text", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
341	+		{name: "other with whitespace-only text", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: " \t\n"}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
342	+		{name: "other with 256 characters", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: strings.Repeat("a", 256)}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
343	+		{name: "text with another reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned, Text: "because"}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
344	+		{name: "text with no reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Text: "because"}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
345	+		{name: "duplicate with no number", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
346	+		{name: "duplicate with a negative number", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate, DuplicateIndex: -1}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
347	+		{name: "number with another reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned, DuplicateIndex: 3}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
348	+		{name: "number with no reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{DuplicateIndex: 3}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
349	+	}
350	+	for _, c := range cases {
351	+		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
352	+			err := c.opts.Validate(c.isPull)
353	+			if c.isErr == nil {
354	+				assert.NoError(t, err)
355	+				return
356	+			}
357	+			assert.True(t, c.isErr(err), "unexpected error: %v", err)
358	+			assert.ErrorIs(t, err, util.ErrInvalidArgument)
359	+		})
360	+	}
361	+}

111	diff --git a/models/issues/issue_close_reason.go b/models/issues/issue_close_reason.go
112	new file mode 100644
113	index 0000000000..7050053e57
114	--- /dev/null
115	+++ b/models/issues/issue_close_reason.go
116	@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
117	+// Copyright 2026 The Gitea Authors. All rights reserved.
118	+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
119	+
120	+package issues
121	+
122	+import (
123	+	"fmt"
124	+	"slices"
125	+	"strings"
126	+	"unicode/utf8"
127	+
128	+	"gitea.dev/modules/util"
129	+)
130	+
131	+// CloseReason records why an issue or pull request was closed.
132	+// It is stored as an integer, so existing values must never be renumbered.
133	+type CloseReason int
134	+
135	+const (
136	+	CloseReasonNone       CloseReason = iota // 0
137	+	CloseReasonCompleted                     // 1
138	+	CloseReasonNotPlanned                    // 2
139	+	CloseReasonDuplicate                     // 3
140	+	CloseReasonOther                         // 4
141	+)
142	+
143	+// CloseReasonUnknown is never stored: it stands for an unrecognised reason name, so that Validate rejects it.
144	+const CloseReasonUnknown CloseReason = -1
145	+
146	+// CloseReasonTextMaxLength matches the VARCHAR(255) close_reason_text column and the close form's MaxSize(255)
147	+// rule. Validate counts characters the same way MaxSize does, so paths that skip the form get the same limit.
148	+const CloseReasonTextMaxLength = 255
149	+
150	+// AllowedCloseReasons lists the reasons a person can pick when closing.
151	+// A pull request is completed by merging, so it cannot be closed as completed.
152	+func AllowedCloseReasons(isPull bool) []CloseReason {
153	+	if isPull {
154	+		return []CloseReason{CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
155	+	}
156	+	return []CloseReason{CloseReasonCompleted, CloseReasonNotPlanned, CloseReasonDuplicate, CloseReasonOther}
157	+}
158	+
159	+// CloseReasonOptions is the reason a person gives when closing an issue or pull request.
160	+type CloseReasonOptions struct {
161	+	Reason         CloseReason
162	+	Text           string // only for CloseReasonOther
163	+	DuplicateIndex int64  // only for CloseReasonDuplicate: the number of the issue it duplicates, in the same repository
164	+}
165	+
166	+// Validate checks the options for an issue or pull request, without looking anything up;
167	+// SetIssueAsClosed checks that the duplicate target exists.
168	+// CloseReasonNone is always valid, so close paths that give no reason keep working.
169	+func (opts CloseReasonOptions) Validate(isPull bool) error {
170	+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonNone && !slices.Contains(AllowedCloseReasons(isPull), opts.Reason) {
171	+		return ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed{Reason: opts.Reason, IsPull: isPull}
172	+	}
173	+
174	+	if opts.Reason == CloseReasonDuplicate {
175	+		if opts.DuplicateIndex <= 0 {
176	+			return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "no issue number given"}
177	+		}
178	+	} else if opts.DuplicateIndex != 0 {
179	+		return ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate{Index: opts.DuplicateIndex, Detail: "an issue number is only allowed with the duplicate reason"}
180	+	}
181	+
182	+	hasText := strings.TrimSpace(opts.Text) != "" // whitespace-only counts as no text
183	+	if opts.Reason != CloseReasonOther {
184	+		if hasText {
185	+			return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is only allowed with the other reason"}
186	+		}
187	+		return nil
188	+	}
189	+	if !hasText {
190	+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: "text is empty"}
191	+	}
192	+	if utf8.RuneCountInString(opts.Text) > CloseReasonTextMaxLength {
193	+		return ErrInvalidCloseReasonText{Reason: opts.Reason, Detail: fmt.Sprintf("text is longer than %d characters", CloseReasonTextMaxLength)}
194	+	}
195	+	return nil
196	+}
197	+
198	+// ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed represents a reason that is out of range, or not allowed for the issue or pull request.
199	+type ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed struct {
200	+	Reason CloseReason
201	+	IsPull bool
202	+}
203	+
204	+// IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed checks if an error is a ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed.
205	+func IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed(err error) bool {
206	+	_, ok := err.(ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed)
207	+	return ok
208	+}
209	+
210	+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Error() string {
211	+	return fmt.Sprintf("close reason is not allowed for this %s [reason: %d]", util.Iif(err.IsPull, "pull request", "issue"), err.Reason)
212	+}
213	+
214	+func (err ErrCloseReasonNotAllowed) Unwrap() error {
215	+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
216	+}
217	+
218	+// ErrInvalidCloseReasonText represents close reason text that is empty, too long, or sent with a reason other than CloseReasonOther.
219	+type ErrInvalidCloseReasonText struct {
220	+	Reason CloseReason
221	+	Detail string
222	+}
223	+
224	+// IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseReasonText.
225	+func IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText(err error) bool {
226	+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseReasonText)
227	+	return ok
228	+}
229	+
230	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Error() string {
231	+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid close reason text: %s [reason: %d]", err.Detail, err.Reason)
232	+}
233	+
234	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseReasonText) Unwrap() error {
235	+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
236	+}
237	+
238	+// ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate represents a duplicate target that is missing, is the issue itself, or is not in the same repository.
239	+type ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate struct {
240	+	Index  int64
241	+	Detail string
242	+}
243	+
244	+// IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate checks if an error is a ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate.
245	+func IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate(err error) bool {
246	+	_, ok := err.(ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate)
247	+	return ok
248	+}
249	+
250	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Error() string {
251	+	return fmt.Sprintf("invalid duplicate target: %s [index: %d]", err.Detail, err.Index)
252	+}
253	+
254	+func (err ErrInvalidCloseDuplicate) Unwrap() error {
255	+	return util.ErrInvalidArgument
256	+}

297	+
298	+	// reload and compare: bean conditions skip unmapped and zero-valued fields, so they can't catch a missing column
299	+	other = unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Issue{ID: 1})
300	+	assert.Equal(t, issues_model.CloseReasonOther, other.CloseReason)
301	+	assert.Equal(t, "superseded by a new design", other.CloseReasonText)
302	+
303	+	duplicate = unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Issue{ID: 2})
304	+	assert.Equal(t, issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate, duplicate.CloseReason)
305	+	assert.EqualValues(t, 1, duplicate.CloseDuplicateIssueID)
306	+}
307	+
308	+func TestAllowedCloseReasons(t *testing.T) {
309	+	assert.Equal(t, []issues_model.CloseReason{

320	+}
321	+
322	+func TestCloseReasonOptionsValidate(t *testing.T) {
323	+	cases := []struct {
324	+		name   string
325	+		opts   issues_model.CloseReasonOptions
326	+		isPull bool
327	+		isErr  func(error) bool // nil when the options are valid
328	+	}{
329	+		{name: "no reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{}},
330	+		{name: "no reason on a pull request", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{}, isPull: true},
331	+		{name: "completed issue", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted}},
332	+		{name: "not planned pull request", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned}, isPull: true},
333	+		{name: "duplicate with a number", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate, DuplicateIndex: 3}},
334	+		{name: "other with text", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: "superseded"}},
335	+		{name: "other with 255 two-byte characters", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: strings.Repeat("é", 255)}},
336	+		{name: "whitespace-only text with another reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted, Text: " "}},
337	+
338	+		{name: "completed pull request", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonCompleted}, isPull: true, isErr: issues_model.IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed},
339	+		{name: "out of range", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: 99}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrCloseReasonNotAllowed},
340	+		{name: "other with no text", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
341	+		{name: "other with whitespace-only text", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: " \t\n"}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
342	+		{name: "other with 256 characters", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: strings.Repeat("a", 256)}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
343	+		{name: "text with another reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned, Text: "because"}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
344	+		{name: "text with no reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Text: "because"}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseReasonText},
345	+		{name: "duplicate with no number", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
346	+		{name: "duplicate with a negative number", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate, DuplicateIndex: -1}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
347	+		{name: "number with another reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonNotPlanned, DuplicateIndex: 3}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
348	+		{name: "number with no reason", opts: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{DuplicateIndex: 3}, isErr: issues_model.IsErrInvalidCloseDuplicate},
349	+	}
350	+	for _, c := range cases {
351	+		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
352	+			err := c.opts.Validate(c.isPull)

354	+				assert.NoError(t, err)
355	+				return
356	+			}
357	+			assert.True(t, c.isErr(err), "unexpected error: %v", err)
358	+			assert.ErrorIs(t, err, util.ErrInvalidArgument)
359	+		})
360	+	}

457	+func TestReopenIssueClearsReason(t *testing.T) {
458	+	cases := []struct {
459	+		name   string
460	+		reason issues_model.CloseReasonOptions
461	+	}{
462	+		{name: "other with text", reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOther, Text: "superseded"}},
463	+		{name: "duplicate", reason: issues_model.CloseReasonOptions{Reason: issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate, DuplicateIndex: 4}},
464	+	}
465	+	for _, c := range cases {
466	+		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
467	+			require.NoError(t, unittest.PrepareTestDatabase())
468	+			issue := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Issue{ID: 1})
469	+			doer := unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &user_model.User{ID: 2})
470	+
471	+			closeComment, err := issues_model.CloseIssue(t.Context(), issue, doer, c.reason)
472	+			require.NoError(t, err)
473	+			reopenComment, err := issues_model.ReopenIssue(t.Context(), issue, doer)
474	+			require.NoError(t, err)
475	+
476	+			issue = unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Issue{ID: 1})
477	+			assert.False(t, issue.IsClosed)
478	+			assert.Equal(t, issues_model.CloseReasonNone, issue.CloseReason)
479	+			assert.Empty(t, issue.CloseReasonText)
480	+			assert.Zero(t, issue.CloseDuplicateIssueID)
481	+
482	+			closeComment = unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Comment{ID: closeComment.ID})
483	+			assert.Equal(t, c.reason.Reason, closeComment.MetaCloseReason().Reason, "the close comment keeps its reason")
484	+			assert.Equal(t, c.reason.Text, closeComment.MetaCloseReason().Text)
485	+			require.NoError(t, closeComment.LoadCloseDuplicateIssue(t.Context()))
486	+			assert.Equal(t, c.reason.Reason == issues_model.CloseReasonDuplicate, closeComment.CloseDuplicateIssue != nil)
487	+
488	+			reopenComment = unittest.AssertExistsAndLoadBean(t, &issues_model.Comment{ID: reopenComment.ID})
489	+			assert.Equal(t, issues_model.CommentTypeReopen, reopenComment.Type)
490	+			assert.Nil(t, reopenComment.CommentMetaData)
491	+		})
492	+	}
493	+}
